events.limits: UI matching implementation absent; case-insensitive glob rule is source instruction, not a measured matching result.

events.condition: At least one changed path matches authoritative UI glob
events.action: Otherwise review ARIA attributes, color-only signals and keyboard parity.
events.effect: Produces APPROVE or REJECT with perspective findings; exact internal skill procedure absent.

events.condition: No data-access or async code present in diff
events.action: Profile description permits SKIP; Tier3 instruction complexity is outside performance scope.
events.effect: Otherwise scans N+1, sync I/O in async paths, hot-loop allocations and unbounded collection growth.
events.limits: Detection and runtime applicability unspecified without reusable performance skill.

events.condition: Any changed prose is LLM-executed Tier3

events.condition: Any changed prose is LLM-executed Tier3

events.effect: Confirmed incorrect behavior in documented scenario BLOCKER; otherwise MINOR.
